title: The UnXplained
description: Africa is the birthplace of humanity and remains one of the most mysterious continents on Earth; from lost cities buried beneath shifting sands, to abandoned ruins steeped in fascinating folklore, to the elusive tomb of history's most mighty queen, what secrets lie hidden throughout Africa's vast and unexplored ancient landscape?

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description: Among the myriad emotions humans have experienced over centuries, perhaps the most easily identifiable is fear; it is because it is essential to our very survival.

title: The Proof Is Out There: Unexplained Edition
description: A man moves cars with his bare hands; a young girl climbs walls like Spider-Man; around the world, people are displaying seemingly superhuman abilities.

title: M*A*S*H
description: A soldier goes AWOL and the 4077th receives fresh eggs from a grateful farmer.

title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
description: How do you master a planet covered by 70% water? Build history-changing machines to conquer it; Dolph Lundgren dives into the stealthy German U-boats that nearly won WWII, the ancient canoes that crossed the Pacific, James Cameron's groundbreaking Deepsea Challenger, and the nuclear-powered aircraft carrier that faced down nuclear war; welcome to Water World.

title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
description: Speed is more than a number, it's human ambition in high octane; Dolph Lundgren hits overdrive with the record-breakers, the Thrust SSC jet car blasting past Mach 1, Concorde's legendary supersonic jet that halved travel times and NASA's Parker Solar Probe, the fastest man-made object in history; fasten your seatbelt for an adrenaline-pumping journey through machines built by speed-obsessed visionaries.

title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
description: Sometimes it really is rocket science with a twist; blast through history with Dolph Lundgren as he reveals the rockets that transformed warfare, exploration and human potential, from the ancient Korean Hwacha artillery that changed battlefields forever, to the Saturn V moon rocket that captured humanity's imagination, to Martin-Baker's rocket-powered ejection seat that saved over 7,000 lives; fasten your seatbelts for a blast of history like you've never seen.

title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
description: If size counts, these machines rewrite all the rules; Dolph Lundgren gets up close inside legendary giants: the Antonov An-225 cargo jet history's largest aircraft; the 200-ton WWII Maus tank designed by Porsche for Hitler, the largest ever made; and Bigfoot, the original monster truck that created a global phenomenon; when small isn't enough, Dolph goes massive with these supersized beasts.

title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
description: Dolph Lundgren pulls the curtain back on the shadowy devices that won secret wars, the CIA's pigeon-mounted spy cameras, bone-conduction radios hidden inside tobacco pipes, the silent heart attack gun and the secret Enigma code that changed WWII.

title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
description: Every once in a while, it's not the weapons and wars that redraw a new world order, but the ideas and inventions; with Dolph Lundgren leading the charge, witnessing the printing press that toppled kings, the Apple II computer dreamed up in a garage and the iconic Model T that put the world on wheels; these revolutionary machines didn't just reshape history, they created it.

title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
description: Feel the thunderous might of the Cold War's atomic cannon, soar with the B-17 bomber that helped win WWII, and witness the cutting-edge technology of today's F-35 stealth fighter jet; guided by Dolph Lundgren, explore the sky-high innovations that gave armies the unbeatable edge in the air.

title: American Pickers
description: In Minnesota, Mike and Jersey go hog wild for a four-generation carny collection complete with carousel horses, toy tanks, and bumper cars; down the road in New Hampshire, on a special mission for Robbie, the guys head to Roger's analog laboratory.

title: Rust Valley Restorers
description: Mike bites off more than he can chew when he helps out with a 1938 Buick Special for an employee, while also racing to finish a 1965 GMC Handi-Van for clients hoping to make up for past mistakes; Mike and Avery train for a local dance competition.

description: Mike indulges himself restoring his very first car, a 1961 Sunbeam; Avery buys an army truck, and recruits Mike to help him bring it home; tempers flare when Avery confronts Mike about the bottom line.

description: Historic floodwaters slam the region, stranding Junior and forcing Big Donny's new hires to step up on a mountain-side tow recovery; Dale needs a helping hand to keep his fledgling business alive.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description: From racing atop ostriches and wrestling wild bears, to raising pet skunks at home and ordering monkeys through the mail, we once welcomed the wild into our lives in some truly staggering ways; these are the unforgettable attractions, unusual pets and head-scratching animal encounters that blurred the line between affection and recklessness; it's a rowdy, unpredictable trip back to the critter-filled close calls that prove our hazardous history was anything but tame.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description: Remember when looking your best meant risking life and limb?; from dentures that could explode at the dinner table and stiff shirt collars that strangled people to death, to toxic hair implants and tanning pills that left them glowing orange.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description: It's history's most famous lost city; the island kingdom that's baffled explorers for centuries; some say Atlantis is a myth, while others insist it was a very real place wiped out thousands of years ago.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description: A trip to the doctor is sure to cure any afflicted individual, but what happens when even the doctors are stunned by what they see?; from a family cursed with blue skin, to a girl allergic to the world's most unlimited resource and more.

title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
description: A broadcast details historical espionage technology and covert surveillance operations; the account examines military tracking sensors used in Vietnam, a nuclear-powered surveillance device placed in the Himalayas and a Soviet listening device concealed within a gift presented to a U.S. ambassador; the documentation highlights how intelligence agencies use disguised tools to gather information during international conflicts.

title: Forged in Fire
description: A look back at the top moments our judges have stepped into the arena to go head-to-head against some of the best smiths in Forged in Fire history.

title: The Food That Built America
description: Through happy accidents and breakthrough flavor innovations, cereal pioneers battle for control of America's breakfast table-using iconic mascots, unforgettable commercials, and bold new ideas to build a billion-dollar industry.
